trigger: all research tasks
execution: name the construct and the measured object once per new design or claim, per CORE-Q02 and EMP-DATA02; silent thereafter unless they diverge

trigger: all research tasks
execution: one-line entry anchor per EMP-ENTRY01 before any estimation output; silent thereafter unless a state is skipped or unevidenced

trigger: empirical/confirmatory tasks
execution: state SEEN_DATA_STATUS before any effect is opened and write the exposure into the register, per GOV-SEEN01 and EMP-BLIND03; silent thereafter

trigger: all staged projects
execution: on any return to an earlier stage or change of claim, record reason, evidence and supersedes, per GOV-DRIFT01 and GOV-STATE02; silent when the claim is unchanged

trigger: literature/evidence claims
execution: name the source tier and authority for each evidence claim, per CORE-LIT06; silent when the claim rests on an already-registered source

trigger: data/code tasks
execution: when host capabilities and permissions permit, run the data/code step directly and report what was executed; escalate only the genuinely blocked acquisition/permission step

trigger: multiple ScholarOps copies or ambiguous release identity
execution: resolve CANONICAL_VERSION_STATUS from explicit release identity and verified fixity when applicable; automatic and silent when a single trusted copy is loaded

trigger: cheap triage finds material missing/selection
execution: full only if triggered

trigger: more than one confirmatory test supports same claim
execution: auto N/A otherwise

trigger: FORMAL_STUDY only, when an economic-effect decision requires SESOI/MDE
execution: NOT_APPLICABLE for technical probe, measurement validation and outcome decision screen; full gate only when triggered

trigger: the same dataset is used repeatedly to choose window, model, rule or sample
execution: lock the specification before formal estimation, or use a reality-check style procedure or holdout; otherwise SPECIFICATION_SEARCH_STATUS=BLOCKED; untriggered→NOT_APPLICABLE

trigger: the research question itself was selected from a heavily searched research universe
execution: raise the evidence hurdle, require independent validation or lower the claim ceiling; owned by 01_CORE at L4, not by the empirical multiplicity gate; untriggered→NOT_APPLICABLE

trigger: OUTCOME_SCREEN_APPLICABILITY=APPLICABLE
execution: freeze SCREEN_DATA_REUSE_POLICY before any effect is opened; default EXTERNAL_HOLDOUT; untriggered→NOT_APPLICABLE

trigger: any formal STOP or STOP_RESOURCE_ALLOCATION verdict
execution: complete S24 termination record before the branch is closed; untriggered→NOT_APPLICABLE

trigger: outcome regression with plausible influential-point risk
execution: pre-spec then B3

trigger: small independent shock/cluster count
execution: CORE-M01

trigger: design actually uses them
execution: load module 06 only

trigger: formal project freeze/handoff/archive or distributable project artifact
execution: assemble the project-specific required artifact package; do not assume repository-maintenance tooling exists in the installed Skill

trigger: data/sample/transform/aggregation changed
execution: identity check only if no change

trigger: stale review, fast-moving field, method/measurement change, or sentinel hit before formal study
execution: freshness sentinel by default; full update only when triggered

trigger: live/dynamic AI system, model/version/tool identity, or other system identity is material to construct
execution: PASS/NOT_APPLICABLE before outcome-bearing execution

trigger: before claiming task complete/PASS/next-step legality or delivering a result
execution: run internal LIGHT closure before claiming complete, PASS or next-step legality, per GOV-CLOSURE01; no extra artifact by default

trigger: freeze/formal handoff/pilot result/formal result/formal dataset/code release/canonical handoff/Skill release
execution: MILESTONE closure with task-specific executable validation
